findings.claim: The landmark_00_local_dx coordinate proxy is non-monotone over the full observed score window [0.0,0.49]: it rises to a positive peak near the middle of the window, then falls to a negative trough, then partially recovers, with 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts across 14 independent batches.

The endpoint rates of landmark_00_local_dx are strongly signed and opposite: first_rate_z is strongly negative and last_rate_z is strongly positive, so the late-window local slope is positive while the early-window slope is negative.

The whole-window mean of landmark_00_local_dx is near zero (whole_window_z small and negative), so the window-integrated level does not distinguish this coordinate; only the within-window contrast does.

A degree-2 polynomial is not accepted for landmark_00_local_dx (polynomial_accepted false, relative_node_RMSE large, held-out batch MSE not improved by higher degree), so a stationary quadratic target is not supported by this curve.

The learning window and observed score times are [0.0,0.5] with 50 observed score nodes at 0.01 spacing, and recorded affinities were removed with an equal score prior; label semantics are recorded affinities removed, not decoded final affinity.

hypotheses.direction: reward the late-window positive local rate relative to the early-window negative local rate, i.e. favor the sign reversal of d(landmark_00_local_dx)/dt across the window
hypotheses.falsifier: the reward edit produces no change in the compiled table or trace, or the realized landmark_00_local_dx curve shows no sign reversal of its local rate over the observed window
hypotheses.scope: global over the observed score window [0.0,0.49]; no extrapolation beyond observed nodes
hypotheses.statement: A time-dependent reward on the landmark_00_local_dx coordinate proxy, contrasting the early-window negative slope against the late-window positive slope, is a supported candidate for the reward lane because the observed curve shows a signed reversal of local rate within the window rather than a stationary level.

hypotheses.direction: do not set an absolute coordinate target or spatial gradient from this contrast; use the contrast only as a relative observable
hypotheses.falsifier: a reward on the window-integrated level of landmark_00_local_dx changes the realized trace in the same direction as a reward on the within-window contrast
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dx whole-window mean versus within-window contrast
hypotheses.scope: global over the observed score window [0.0,0.49]
hypotheses.statement: Because the whole-window mean of landmark_00_local_dx is near zero while the within-window contrast is large, a reward that targets only the window-integrated level of this coordinate is not supported; the contrast, not the absolute level, is the observable that carries the observed signal.

limitations: Stage profiles and temporal profiles are not available; only continuous curves are delivered, so no stage boundary is claimed.
The curve is a coordinate proxy in predicted endpoint world-A features; no energy or chemical-interaction interpretation is attached.
Selection preference is association evidence only; it is not descendant survival, last recorded joint-head scores, or decoded final affinity, and decoded labels are unobserved.
The degree-2 polynomial is not accepted and the curve has 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts, so a single stationary target across the whole window is not supported.
No current study quality outcomes are available to the role; the hypotheses are not observed guidance effects.
